## Client updates
### Besu: 
-  all stack implemented
### geth update: 
- close to done with implementing megaspec opcodes, about to start testing with reference tests
- Feedback about the EOF Megaspec - OPCODE defers to the spec of other OPCODE, spec not perfect but "OK"

## Spec update:
- EIPs 3540 4750 and 5450 are now aligned with EOF megaspec document
- EIP 7620 has some minor clarifications pending review
- Add Meta EIP soon to be merged
- Current state of testing EOF was discussed with the testing team.

## testing team: 
- hold off contributing to ethereum-spec-tests, after a couple of days more infrastructure will be ready to accept contributions.

- EOF Banning code introspection was discussed.

## Next call:
- discuss EOF version without irregular state change (https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/78) and EOF version without TXCREATE (https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/76 - this one needs a slight update, tbd soon), after everyone gets on the same page with the proposals
- discuss initcode mode validation (https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/86)
- discuss RETURNDATA* 0-padding (https://github.com/ipsilon/eof/pull/90)
 
(Thanks @pdobacz for notes)
